## Relationships

### [Flora Jane](../character/flora-jane.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/flora-jane--spencer.md)

[Flora Jane](../character/flora-jane.md) is the daughter of Mrs. Spencer. When [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) visits the Spencer home to address a mix-up regarding Anne's adoption, [Flora Jane](../character/flora-jane.md) is present alongside her mother. She appears briefly as a member of Mrs. Spencer's household during this interaction.

- Parent of  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P4](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0004)</sub>
